papers.title: Thermal Processing Limits in Oxide-Channel Ferroelectric Field Effect Transistors
papers.summary: In this work, we report a systematic study of the impact of high-temperature post-capping thermal annealing on the memory characteristics of Oxide-semiconductor channel ferroelectric field-effect transistors (OS-FeFETs). Using an identical engineered ferroelectric gate stack—8 nm Hf ${}_{{0}.{5}}$ Zr ${}_{{0}.{5}}$ O 2 (HZO) / 3 nm Al 2 O 3 / 8 nm HZO (8/3/8)—and a hybrid capping layer (3 nm HfO ${}_{{2}} +3$ nm Al 2 O 3 ), 10% Ga-doped In 2 O 3 (IGO)–channel and 4% W-doped In 2 O 3 (IWO)–channel FeFETs remain functional after annealing at temperatures up to $650~^{\circ } $ C for durations of up to 30 min and 10 min, respectively; further annealing results in irreversible loss of conduction and device failure. Detailed electrical analysis reveals that the MW enhancement originates from a preferential positive shift in the erased-state threshold voltage, while the programmed-state threshold voltage remains comparatively stable. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction measurements further indicate structural evolution in the IWO and IGO oxide channels with increasing annealing temperature, supporting the observed electrical trends.
papers.abstract_cn: 本工作系统研究了高温加帽后热退火对氧化物半导体沟道铁电场效应晶体管（OS-FeFET）存储特性的影响。采用相同的工程化铁电栅堆叠——8 nm Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂（HZO）/3 nm Al₂O₃/8 nm HZO（8/3/8）——以及复合加帽层（3 nm HfO₂+3 nm Al₂O₃）时，采用10% Ga掺杂In₂O₃（IGO）沟道和4% W掺杂In₂O₃（IWO）沟道的FeFET，在最高650 ℃的温度下分别退火最长30 min和10 min后仍能正常工作；进一步退火则会导致导电能力不可逆丧失和器件失效。详细的电学分析表明，存储窗口（MW）的增大源于擦除态阈值电压优先向正方向偏移，而编程态阈值电压则保持相对稳定。掠入射X射线衍射测量进一步表明，随着退火温度升高，IWO和IGO氧化物沟道发生了结构演变，这与所观察到的电学变化趋势相符。

papers.title: Rectangular Four-Level Stacked SiGe Nanosheet GAA Transistors Based on Si/SiGe Stacks Enabled by a Novel SGI-TMAH Channel Release Process
papers.summary: To overcome SiGe channel loss and morphology degradation during channel release, a novel SiGe inhibitor-added TMAH (SGI-TMAH) solution is developed for SiGe nanosheet GAA transistors. Compared with the previously reported S-TMAH solution, SGI-TMAH improves the Si to SiGe selectivity from 23.5:1 to 80.6:1, enabling four-level stacked rectangular SiGe nanosheets from conventional Si/SiGe stacks. As a result, the footprint-normalized I ON increases by 41.1% while maintaining an I ON /I OFF ratio above $10^{{6}}$ . Although some degradation in SS, DIBL, and I OFF is observed due to weakened electrostatic control, further nanosheet scaling toward ~5 nm should improve electrostatic characteristics. This work validates a feasible channel release scheme applicable to SiGe channel GAA technologies.
papers.abstract_cn: 为解决沟道释放过程中SiGe沟道损失和形貌劣化的问题，本文针对SiGe纳米片全环绕栅（GAA）晶体管开发了一种新型添加SiGe抑制剂的TMAH（SGI-TMAH）溶液。与此前报道的S-TMAH溶液相比，SGI-TMAH将Si相对于SiGe的刻蚀选择比从23.5:1提高至80.6:1，从而能够基于常规Si/SiGe堆叠形成四层堆叠的矩形SiGe纳米片。因此，在保持I_ON/I_OFF比大于10⁶的同时，按占用面积归一化的I_ON提高了41.1%。尽管由于静电控制能力减弱，亚阈值摆幅（SS）、漏致势垒降低（DIBL）和I_OFF出现了一定程度的劣化，但进一步将纳米片缩小至约5 nm应能改善其静电特性。本工作验证了一种可应用于SiGe沟道GAA技术的可行沟道释放方案。

papers.title: 600 V/1 A Enhancement-Mode β -Ga 2 O 3 MOSFETs With Graded Doping Engineering
papers.summary: In this letter, we have demonstrated high performance enhancement-mode (E-mode) $\beta $ -Ga 2 O 3 recessed-gate metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect- transistors (RG-MOSFETs) with ampere-level drain current ( ${I}_{\text {D}}\text {)}$ and > 600 V breakdown voltage (BV) via graded channel doping engineering. With the n + - and n-Ga 2 O 3 layers beneath the gate etched and the unintentional doped- (UID-)Ga 2 O 3 preserved, the threshold voltage ( ${V}_{\text {TH}}\text {)}$ with high uniformity of 9 V, a recorded top-gate E-mode ${I}_{\text {D}}$ of 130 mA/mm and low specific on-resistance ( ${R}_{\text {on, {sp}}}\text {)}$ of 19 m $\Omega \cdot $ cm 2 are all achieved for small periphery FETs. Combined with source and gate field plates (FP), the small periphery RG-MOSFET with gate-to-drain spacing ( ${L}_{\text {GD}}\text {)}$ of $10~\mu $ m demonstrates a high BV of $2.46~{k}$ V, yielding a state-of-the-art power figure of merit (P-FOM) of 318 MW/cm 2 . By scaling the gate width ( ${W}_{\text {ch}}\text {)}$ to 20 mm, Ampere-level ${I}_{\text {D}}$ with BV > 600 V was also achieved with ${V}_{\text {TH}}$ maintained to be ~9 V, showing a high process variation immunity. Given the significant potential of $\beta $ -Ga 2 O 3 MOSFETs in power devices, such E-mode high-current and high-voltage results verify their great promises for next-generation electronics.
papers.abstract_cn: 本文通过梯度沟道掺杂工程，实现了具有安培级漏极电流（I_D）和超过600 V击穿电压（BV）的高性能增强型（E-mode）β-Ga₂O₃凹栅金属-氧化物-半导体场效应晶体管（RG-MOSFET）。通过刻蚀栅极下方的n⁺-Ga₂O₃层和n-Ga₂O₃层，同时保留非故意掺杂（UID）Ga₂O₃层，小周长FET实现了均匀性良好的9 V阈值电压（V_TH）、创纪录的130 mA/mm顶栅增强型漏极电流I_D，以及19 mΩ·cm²的低比导通电阻（R_on,sp）。结合源极场板和栅极场板（FP），栅漏间距（L_GD）为10 μm的小周长RG-MOSFET表现出2.46 kV的高击穿电压，由此获得318 MW/cm²的先进功率品质因数（P-FOM）。将栅极宽度（W_ch）扩展至20 mm后，在阈值电压V_TH仍保持约9 V的情况下，同样实现了安培级I_D和超过600 V的击穿电压，显示出对工艺波动的高度耐受性。鉴于β-Ga₂O₃ MOSFET在功率器件领域的巨大潜力，这些增强型大电流、高电压结果证实了其在下一代电子技术中的广阔应用前景。

papers.title: The Ballistic Injection in IGZO GAA VFET With Scaled Source/Drain Extension and Its Impact on On-Current Enhancement
papers.summary: In this work, the impact of source/drain (S/D) extension scaling on the performance of indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) gate-all-around (GAA) vertical field-effect transistors (VFETs) is systematically studied both theoretically and experimentally. The electron transport at the S/D extension is investigated by drift-diffusion (DD) simulation and ballistic injection simulation. It is observed that the I-V characteristics at high V DS of IGZO GAA VFET with scaled S/D extension deviate significantly from the velocity saturation model due to the electron velocity overshoot at the S/D extension region. A ballistic injection model is introduced that can well explain the experimental I-V characteristics. It is found that the S extension scaling, rather than the D extension scaling, is more effective for on-current (I ${}_{\text {on}}\text {)}$ enhancement. By S extension scaling (down to 5 nm), the I on enhancement is demonstrated experimentally, showing a high I on of $569~\mu $ A/ $\mu $ m (V ${}_{\text {D}} =2.2$ V).
papers.abstract_cn: 本工作从理论和实验两方面系统研究了源/漏（S/D）延伸区缩短对铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）全环绕栅（GAA）垂直场效应晶体管（VFET）性能的影响。采用漂移-扩散（DD）模拟和弹道注入模拟研究了S/D延伸区中的电子输运。研究发现，在高V_DS下，具有缩短S/D延伸区的IGZO GAA VFET的I-V特性由于S/D延伸区中的电子速度过冲而显著偏离速度饱和模型。本文引入了一种能够很好解释实验I-V特性的弹道注入模型。研究发现，与漏极（D）延伸区缩短相比，源极（S）延伸区缩短对提高导通电流（I_on）更为有效。通过将S延伸区缩短至5 nm，实验上验证了I_on的提升，并获得了569 μA/μm（V_D=2.2 V）的高I_on。

papers.title: Tuning Linearity of IGZO Synaptic Transistor With Low-Power by Oxygen Vacancy Engineering for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.summary: We propose an N 2 plasma treatment for controlling oxygen vacancies to enhance the linearity of indium-gallium-zinc oxide (IGZO) synaptic transistors. Oxygen vacancies are intentionally generated via Ar bombardment during IGZO sputtering and subsequently passivated by N 2 plasma. This process suppresses persistent photoconductivity, which is a primary limitation in photonic synapses for fast recovery. Our approach yields robust synaptic behaviors, including long-term potentiation and spike-time-dependent plasticity. Crucially, the weight update nonlinearity factor is reduced from 1.55 to 0.41, enabling accurate artificial neural network learning.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种用于调控氧空位的N₂等离子体处理方法，以提高铟镓锌氧化物（IGZO）突触晶体管的线性度。在IGZO溅射过程中，首先通过Ar轰击有意产生氧空位，随后利用N₂等离子体对其进行钝化。该工艺抑制了持续光电导效应，而持续光电导是限制光子突触快速恢复的主要因素。采用该方法制备的器件表现出稳健的突触行为，包括长期增强和脉冲时序依赖可塑性。尤为重要的是，权重更新非线性因子从1.55降低至0.41，从而能够实现准确的人工神经网络学习。

papers.title: A Scaling Theory for the Nonlinear Subthreshold Behavior of Cryogenic Ultrathin Body MOSFETs
papers.summary: The subthreshold swing (SS) is expected to scale linearly with temperature, $\text {SS}_{\text {B}} = \text {(}\text {k}_{\text {B}}\text {T}/\text {q}\text {)}\ln {10}$ , yet experimental data from cryogenic UTB (Si, MoS 2 , and In 2 O 3 ) MOSFETs exhibit anomalous temperature-dependent nonlinearities characterized by negative differential SS and multiple plateaus. Here we use the Landauer formulation to rigorously derive the scaling relationship $\text {SS} = \text {SS}_{\text {B}}\cdot [{1}+\gamma \text {(}\text {T}_{\text {R}}/\text {T}\text {)}^{\text {T}/\text {T}_{\text {W}}}]$ for constant diffusivity to capture the universality and robustness of SS anomalies reported in the literature. The temperature scales ( $\text {T}_{\text {W}}, \text {T}_{\text {R}}$ ) are respectively related to the intrinsic properties of the band-tail states and reference current, and as such, can be used as a diagnostic quality monitor of as-fabricated and stress-degraded MOSFET.
papers.abstract_cn: 亚阈值摆幅（SS）理论上应随温度线性缩放，即SS_B=(k_BT/q)ln 10；然而，低温超薄体（UTB）Si、MoS₂和In₂O₃ MOSFET的实验数据表现出反常的温度依赖非线性，其特征包括负微分SS和多个平台区。本文采用Landauer形式体系，在扩散系数恒定的条件下严格推导出缩放关系SS=SS_B·[1+γ(T_R/T)^(T/T_W)]，以描述文献所报道SS异常现象的普适性和稳健性。温度尺度（T_W、T_R）分别与带尾态的本征性质和参考电流相关，因此可用作诊断性质量监测指标，以评估制造完成时以及应力退化后的MOSFET。

papers.title: Vertical Integration of Noncarrier Injection Nano-LEDs and Transistors With Controllable Bandwidth for Selective Driving of Parallel Arrays: Modeling and Simulation
papers.summary: The emerging noncarrier injection mode applied to nanopixel light-emitting display is expected to propel display technology toward a trend of highly interdisciplinary integration. However, achieving precise brightness modulation and driving remains a critical challenge. In this work, we propose a nano-scale light-emitting junction field-effect transistor (LE-JFET) with structure of vertical integration of noncarrier injection nano-LEDs and transistors. The electro-optic conversion performance of LE-JFET is studied by the finite element simulation. The dynamic variation of carrier concentration is studied to analyze the working mechanism. The LE-JFET exhibits unique frequency selective characteristics, demonstrating a gate-controlled optimal frequency point for light emission, which provides a potential approach for realizing the one line-to-multi LEDs driving method. The results of this work provide a new strategy for the realization of ultrahigh resolution displays and open a new perspective on future display technology applications.
papers.abstract_cn: 应用于纳米像素发光显示的新兴非载流子注入模式，有望推动显示技术向高度跨学科集成的方向发展。然而，实现精确的亮度调制与驱动仍是一项关键挑战。本工作提出了一种纳米尺度发光结型场效应晶体管（LE-JFET），其结构由非载流子注入型纳米LED与晶体管垂直集成而成。本文通过有限元模拟研究了LE-JFET的电光转换性能，并通过研究载流子浓度的动态变化分析其工作机制。LE-JFET表现出独特的频率选择特性，显示出由栅极控制的最佳发光频率点，为实现一条线路驱动多个LED的方法提供了一种潜在途径。本工作的结果为实现超高分辨率显示提供了新策略，并为未来显示技术的应用开辟了新的视角。

papers.title: Ionic Field-Effect Transistor Achieving Large Memory Window and Enhanced Retention via Ultrathin Ozone-Oxidized Barrier Layer
papers.summary: We propose an ionic field-effect transistor (Ionic FET) based on a WO ${}_{\text{3-}x}$ /HfOx ECRAM stack that stores information via ionic-charge-induced threshold voltage (V ${}_{\text {th}}\text {)}$ modulation, enabling scalable analog state control. To relax the trade-off between ion injection and retention, an ultrathin ion barrier layer formed by ozone oxidation suppresses ion back-diffusion while preserving sufficient injection. The device achieves a large memory window of ~7.6 V with linear Vth modulation, stable 3-bit multi-level operation ( $\sigma $ / $\mu \lt 0.1$ ), and endurance over $10^{{5}}$ program/erase cycles. By raising the activation energy for ion back-diffusion, the ozone-treated barrier yields a projected room-temperature retention exceeding $10^{{6}}$ sec.
papers.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于WO₃₋ₓ/HfOₓ ECRAM堆叠的离子场效应晶体管（Ionic FET），该器件通过离子电荷诱导的阈值电压（V_th）调制来存储信息，从而实现可扩展的模拟状态控制。为缓解离子注入与保持特性之间的权衡，通过臭氧氧化形成了一层超薄离子阻挡层，在保留足够离子注入能力的同时抑制离子反向扩散。该器件实现了约7.6 V的大存储窗口和线性的V_th调制，能够进行稳定的3 bit多级操作（σ/μ<0.1），并可承受超过10⁵次编程/擦除循环。通过提高离子反向扩散的活化能，经臭氧处理的阻挡层使器件在室温下的预计保持时间超过10⁶ s。
